about: The one type scale of cmux NEXT, native and web (Leo 2026-10-13: unify the font sizes). scripts/cmux-next/gen-type-scale.py writes the CSS tokens (webviews/src/pages/shared/desktop.css) and the Swift ones (CmuxNextDesign/TypeScale.generated.swift) from this file. Sizes are points on macOS and CSS px in the webviews; reading content (transcript, prompt) follows the user's content size and is not a step.

font.about: The UI font of every chrome surface, native and web (Leo 2026-10-21, ask-52da478628: Inter, bundled, with its calculated tracking). Pinned by leo-bans.json; scripts/cmux-next/check-leo-bans.py fails when it changes without Leo's order. CSS names the face `family` (`--font-ui`, the bundled WOFF2); AppKit finds the registered TTF by `fileFamily`, its own name. `fallback` follows it in --font-ui.

tracking.about: Letter spacing per size, in em: a + b * e^(c * size), size in px (pt natively). Inter's dynamic metrics (rsms, Inter docs). gen-type-scale.py writes each step's `tracking` from these constants (4 decimals); natively every Inter font gets em * size points of kern at its own size. The other recorded value is the 2026-10-19 study's flat -0.011em versus SF Pro (a = -0.011, b = 0); change the constants only with Leo's order.
